name: code-tutor-narrator
description: Lets an agent drive VS Code as a tutor: scroll to code, highlight it, and narrate it aloud. Exposes an MCP server.

commands.title: Code Tutor: Set ElevenLabs API Key

codeTutor.port.description: Loopback port for the MCP server.

codeTutor.voice.description: macOS `say` voice used for narration. Run `say -v '?'` to list.

enumDescriptions: macOS built-in speech. Free, offline, instant.
ElevenLabs cloud TTS. Best quality, billed per character.
Pipe the text to any command on stdin (Kokoro, Piper, a curl script).
codeTutor.tts.provider.description: Which speech backend to narrate with.

codeTutor.tts.command.description: Shell command for the 'command' provider. Receives narration text on stdin and is responsible for playing it.

codeTutor.elevenlabs.voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice id. Find them at elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library.

codeTutor.elevenlabs.modelId.description: eleven_flash_v2_5 is ~75ms and half the price; eleven_multilingual_v2 is richer but slower.

codeTutor.elevenlabs.baseUrl.description: API base URL. Override for a proxy or a test stub.

codeTutor.elevenlabs.stability.description: 0 is expressive and variable, 1 is flat and consistent.

codeTutor.elevenlabs.similarityBoost.description: How closely to match the reference voice.

codeTutor.cacheAudio.description: Cache synthesised audio on disk, so repeating a walkthrough costs nothing.
